Method of Attack: Encrypting files on ASUSTOR NAS devices and demanding ransom in bitcoins
Using a zero-day vulnerability to encrypt NAS devices
Replacing ASUSTOR login screen with ransom note
Renaming files to include .deadbolt file extension
Demanding ransom payment to receive decryption key via bitcoin transaction OP_RETURN output
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability (alleged) in ASUSTOR NAS devices
Possible vulnerability in PLEX media server or EZ Connect allowing access
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note files: index.cgi and ALL YOUR FILES HAVE BEEN LOCKED BY DEADBOLT.html
ASUSTOR login screen replaced with ransom note
